game.title: Unknown 9: Awakening
game.blurb: Third-person action-adventure with stealth and the supernatural power of Stepping, from Reflector Entertainment, released 2024-10-17. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Unknown 9: Awakening" or "Unknown 9". unknown9.fandom.com redirects "Unknown 9: Awakening" to a short "Awakening" page that links only 3 articles ("Reflector Entertainment", "Bandai Namco Entertainment Europe", "Unknown 9 Universe"), so it gave no structure; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Jacket" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1477940. 14 of 38 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story chapter. Their names ("On Your Own Now", "An Orphan Reborn", "The Yankee's Prize", "Going Dark" and so on) read like story chapters, but the data gives no order beyond the Steam list. "Killer Instinct" and "Puppeteer" mention stepping into enemies, so they sit in the Stepping chapter rather than with stealth.
